name: web-forager
description: Clean-room, robots-aware web information gathering for agents and analysts. HTTP mode searches 360/Bing/Sogou, reads HTML/PDF/DOCX/XLSX/EPUB/CSV and RSS/Atom, collects public pages from Bilibili through a dedicated adapter and reads other sites as ordinary pages, extracts metadata and tables, discovers sitemaps and caches politely. Browser mode drives a real browser through a pluggable bridge for login-state pages, rendered content, danmaku and seven read-only playbooks covering Bilibili, Zhihu and Xiaohongshu. Optional scholarly lookups cover arXiv/Crossref/PubMed/DOI. Ships a CLI, an --agent envelope, and two stdio MCP servers.
disclaimer: 本插件仅供学习与信息收集使用。使用者需遵守目标网站的 Terms of Service 及相关版权法律。禁止用于抓取个人隐私数据或进行恶意并发攻击。
